1
.This Memo follows on from ADM Memo 12/25 which gave guidance on
 
The Welfare Reform Act 2012
(Commencement No. 35) (Abolition of Benefits) Order 2025
1
. That Commencement Order is now
amended through a new Order – The Welfare Reform Act 2012 (Commencement No.35) (Abolition of
Benefits) (Amendment) Order 2026
2
. This Memo gives guidance on the new Order and should be read
in conjunction with ADM Memo 12/25.

2
.Commencement Order No.35 is amended in relation to Income-related Employment and Support
Allowance (ESA(IR)) and Housing Benefit (HB) for working age persons.

3
.For anyone whose ESA(IR) award is not already abolished the date of abolition will be 
01/07/26
,
except for

3.1
 
those claimants who have a two-week run-on period of ESA(IR) still to elapse, for whom the 
abolition will take place at the end of the run-on period
1
 
or

3.2 
where an appointee is acting for the claimant immediately before 01/07/26, or where the 
Secretary of State determines an appointee was likely to be needed (in the six months prior to 
01/07/26), where there is no abolition date
2 
until one of the events in paragraph 4 occurs.

4.
Where someone in the 
3.2
 cohort does make a claim to UC, or does not make a claim to UC by the
deadline set in their Managed Migration notice, the normal abolition dates then apply
3
 (i.e. where a claim
was made, after the two-week run-on period
4
, or where no claim was made, after two weeks beginning 
with the deadline date).
5

1 
WRA 12, CO 35, Art 3A(1)
; 2 
Art 3A(2)
; 3 
Art 3A(3)
; 4 
UC (MM Pilot) Regs 2019  
   
, Reg 5(1)  
; 5 
UC TP Regs 2014,
 
Reg 46(1)

5
. The original Commencement Order No.35 provided for the following abolition date for HB claimants in 
temporary or specified accommodation, who then leave that accommodation
1
 (see paragraph 13 of ADM 
Memo 12/25):
13. The date of abolition of HB in relation to an award of HB where the claimant

13.1
 
is 
not 
entitled to UC, IS JSA(IB) 
or
 ESA(IR), 
and

13.2
 
is 
not
 someone over the qualifying age for state pension credit (including those in 
protected mixed age couples,) 
and

13.3
 
is entitled to that award in respect of specified or temporary accommodation,

is any day falling on or after 
14/11/25
 that is the day after the last day on which the claimant is 
entitled to HB in respect of specified or temporary accommodation.

6
. This now applies for the period from 
14/11/25
 up to (but not including) 
01/07/26
2
. On 01/07/26 they 
will be subject to the provisions set out in paragraph 7 below when leaving temporary or specified 
accommodation.

1 
UC TP Regs 2014, Reg 2(1)
; 2 
WRA 12, CO35, Art 6
NOT IN TEMPORARY OR SPECIFIED ACCOMODATION

7
. The date for the abolition of HB for persons 
not
 in temporary or specified accommodation
1
 is 
01/07/26
, except where the award of HB

7.2
 
is due to terminate at the end of a two-week run-on period
3
 (the abolition date being the day 
after the run-on period)
3

7.3 
is made to a claimant also in receipt of old-style ESA, who had an appointee appointed 
immediately before 01/07/26 or needs to have one appointed (see paragraph 
3.2
. and 
4
 above)
4
,

7.4
. is for someone in prison (or serving a sentence in hospital)
5
 immediately before 01/07/26
6
 
(the abolition date being the day after the day they are released from prison/hospital), 
or

7.5
 
is for someone over the qualifying age for state pension credit, including those in protected 
mixed age couples (for whom there is no abolition date).
7

Existing arrangements for such referrals should be followed, as set out in Memo ADM
 
07/19
